fields.description: A Dubailand neighbourhood of three- to five-bedroom townhouses and villas. Taormina combines multi-level homes with shared outdoor spaces; the villa and townhouse schedules should be compared separately.

sources.label: Taormina · original brochure with complete home plans

research.locationNote: The developer identifies Dubailand. Property Finder uses Majan; confirm the contractual parcel.
overview: The developer’s current page describes 838 homes; its Village 1 parcel drawing covers a smaller 530-home scope.
research.priceNote: Property Finder records an AED 3.4 million launch reference and marks the project sold out. This is not a current available-unit offer.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 30% at launch and 70% during construction. Its 30/70 heading does not mean 70% on handover; a developer-issued schedule was not verified.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder anticipates December 2027. This remains a portal forecast, not a completion certificate or unit-specific contractual date.
